name: Elf

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.description: You perceive Dim Light as Bright Light, without a separate range limit. This does not permit you to see through Darkness.
Gain +2 Listen and +2 Spot. Existing Perception composite calculation uses these bonuses.
Advantage on saving throws to resist or end Charmed.
Complete a Long Rest through four hours of trancelike meditation. Elves do not need to sleep.
Immune to magical sleep that is not willingly accepted. Can consent to a specific magical sleep effect; this is not a general immunity toggle.

reviewNotes: Speed and overall trait balance will be compared with other Species.
Native Low-Light Vision replaces base 60-foot Darkvision in the approved comparative vision review; a specifically darkness-adapted Ancestry can still grant Darkvision.

Creature type Fey selected in the nine-Species comparative review. Explicit Fey targeting eligibility applies, but monster Outsider/Fey defaults (Hit Dice, vision, senses, competencies, and biological needs) are not automatically granted to playable characters.
No Species-level default Upbringing: General Elf is inheritance-only; playable Elven Ancestries provide their own selectable cultural suggestions, and cross-cultural Upbringings remain available.
